projects.title: Avatar – Real-time Facial Landmark Detection and Rendering
projects.description:
Github Link: https://github.com/zhucebuliaolongchuan/avatar.git
1. Implemented and optimized 68-points facial landmark detection and tracking based on Dlib machine learning framework, sparse Optical Flow and Kalman Filter, made detection and tracking faster and more stable
2. Implemented head pose estimation and face mask rendering using OpenGL, facial motion capture and avatar rendering in Maya
